assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent palpitations and intermittent lightheadedness in the setting of known atrial fibrillation and a personal history of transient ischemic attacks.
Mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229) is ordered to correlate these symptomatic episodes with arrhythmic events and to optimize rate control and anticoagulation management.
The service ordered is Mobile cardiac telemetry with CPT code 93229.
The documented indication I48.91 is present.
The documented indication G45.9 is present.
The documented indication Z86.73 is present.
The indications are in accordance with the documented indications I48.91, G45.9, and Z86.73.
